steps.do: Check eligibility: at least one active checking account exists; the earliest active one's date_opened is at least 14 days before the current time (get_time); the customer holds fewer than 5 personal savings accounts; no account is in collections or has a negative balance. If tenure is under 14 days, tell the customer the date they become eligible (14 days after that date_opened) and stop. If they already hold 5 savings accounts, tell them they have reached the maximum and stop. If any account is in collections or negative, explain it must be resolved first and stop. If there is no active checking account, explain one is required and stop.
steps.quote: Do not proceed if any item above is not met.

basis.quote: Customer has at least one active Rho-Bank checking account.
Insufficient checking tenure: If the checking account has been open fewer than 14 days, advise the customer when they will become eligible.
Exceeds savings account limit: If the customer already has 5 personal savings accounts, do not open a new one. Inform the customer they have reached the maximum.
Collections or negative balances: Resolve these issues first; do not proceed until all accounts are in good standing.

steps.do: Compare every personal savings account against the customer's needs and recommend ONE that meets all of them, applying card-holder benefits only when get_credit_cards shows the card. Drop any account whose opening deposit or ongoing minimum is above what the customer can keep, whose free withdrawals are below their monthly count, that lacks ATM rebates they need, whose APY at their balance is below their target, or that requires paperless statements when they need paper. Example: for 12–15 withdrawals a month, a balance of a few thousand dollars, ATM rebates and goals tracking, Silver Plus Account fits (15 free withdrawals, 3.0% Tier 1, rebates up to 25, goals tracking); Gold needs $10,000. Mention the $1,000 opening deposit, the $2,500 minimum and the $8.00 fee below it.

done_when: The customer is verified and logged, and the chosen savings account is open. The customer has been told the funding status (the amount they asked for was transferred) or the 30-day funding deadline with the opening deposit minimum. They have also been told the documented consequence of a balance below the minimum, the paper-statement terms when they need paper, and that a card's APY bonus applies automatically. Alternatively, an eligibility check failed and the customer was told what to resolve (for short tenure, the date they become eligible), or the opening failed and the customer was told why and offered a transfer. If requested, opening a checking account follows.
